commentary_title: Freight rates hold firm amid soft demand
commentary_summary: The LR2 tonne-miles index gained 9 points over the week ending at 98.0. While market activity remained on the quieter side due to the International Energy week, freight rates held firm. The vessels at port and at anchor declined MoM as a higher number of vessels travelled underway, pushing up tonne-miles in the previous week. | Week 10 could see freight rates firm up, as the rise in tonnage underway might help support rates. A lack of tonnage and some refineries coming back online could boost tonne-mile demand.
